pages.text: While a Vindicator can be raised as a Zombie, a Pillager a Skeleton, to truly make a proper undead version of the powerful Evokers and other Illager spellcasters, one must be more... spiritual in their pursuit.

Unlike the other two, Bound Evokers can float above ground and is unaffected by gravity. Despite their spiritual looks, they cannot phase through walls and can still be harmed with conventional weaponry.
No longer bound to the ground, these undead spellcasters nonetheless retain their mastery over the earth.
Bound Iceologers are as chilly as they are in life but, this time, their Ice Chunks are falling on someone else's head instead of yours.

As teary as they are in life, the undead Cryologers will rain hail and conjure walls upon their enemies. For some reason, despite their teary-eyed appearance, they seemed to be less miserable and more apathetic to their predicament than the other bound illagers.
These Illagers retain their power over the wind in death, with a neat caveat of truly being able to fly rather than slowly fall to the ground.
Not even death can stop the storm within these plunderers, and they're willing to reveal it to their foes.
These bound souls can be healed by right-clicking on them with Ectoplasm.

As they still retain their mental faculties, these souls can be given your $(l:goety:mutations/illager_servants#banner)personal banner$() and lead your $(l:goety:mutations/illager_servants)Illager servants$() as well.
